source_reason: 每个日历事件描述应同时写明 Show 1–4 的期数和本期精选 Afrobeat 播放列表。编排只要求按期编号并核对事件身份，没有要求写入或验收播放列表说明。
interpretation: 在每个日历事件的创建payload与get_event回读中明确同时要求对应Show期数和冻结Afrobeat播放列表说明；已存在的唯一目标事件若描述不完整，仅补其描述并再验。保持原版主agent直做、事件原生并行、不新增Word/Calendar并行分支。

changes.original: Create only missing `Afrobeat Sunday Show` events natively in parallel on April 5/12/19/26 with exact UTC `start.dateTime`/`end.dateTime`, no local timezone, and Show 1–4 descriptions; retain each returned/reused ID and call `get_event`.
changes.replacement: Create only missing `Afrobeat Sunday Show` events natively in parallel on April 5/12/19/26 with exact UTC `start.dateTime`/`end.dateTime`, no local timezone. Supply a complete description for every event: the corresponding show number (Show 1 on April 5, Show 2 on April 12, Show 3 on April 19, Show 4 on April 26) and a brief note about the Afrobeat playlist that will be featured, grounded in the frozen playlist and naming supported featured tracks/artists rather than inventing a new playlist. A show number alone is not an acceptable description. Retain each returned/reused ID and call `get_event`; verify the exact date, 20:00–22:00 UTC interval, title, corresponding show number, and the nonempty featured-playlist note against the frozen playlist. If a uniquely matched target event already exists but its description lacks the required show number or playlist note, the main agent updates only that event's description through the task-approved calendar tool, preserving its identity and exact UTC interval, then calls `get_event` again. Do not alter non-target events or treat an incomplete description as a verified booking.
